values.official_title: Mitigating Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults With Breast Cancer Receiving Chemotherapy: Memory and Attention Adaptation Training-Geriatrics (MAAT-G): A Randomized Pilot Study
values.primary_outcome_measure: Mean of the Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy-Cognition (FACT-COG)
